title: GDS Job Spec
description: A single GDS job: one graph projection plus the algorithms to compute, which results to materialize into the in-session graph (mutate), and which to persist to the database (write). This is the same document the gds-jobs-api Go server validates a single job against.

compute.description: Ordered list of algorithms to run against the job's graph. Each produces a resultProperty; a later compute can consume an earlier one's result once it has been mutated into the graph.

mutate.description: Optional override: produced properties to force-materialize into the in-session graph. Materialization is normally auto-derived - a produced property is materialized when a later compute names it as an input (e.g. featureProperties). A written property that is never materialized is written directly from the compute result (saving session memory).

write.description: Produced properties to persist to the database.

project.description: A projection is `cypher` (a Cypher `query`) or `native` (`nodeLabels` + `relationshipTypes`) - both read from the connected DB - or `construct` (built from a graph `file` via gds.graph.construct, no DB needed).

query.description: cypher projection: a Cypher query returning gds.graph.project(...). Mutually exclusive with the native/file fields.

file.description: construct projection: path to a graph file (JSON construct format or a `kind: random` spec) built into the session via gds.graph.construct (no database needed).

nodeLabels.description: native projection: node labels to include.

relationshipTypes.description: native projection: relationship types to include.

nodeProperties.description: native projection: node properties to load.

relationshipProperties.description: native projection: relationship properties to load.

undirectedRelationshipTypes.description: Relationship types to treat as UNDIRECTED (required by algorithms like triangleCount / localClusteringCoefficient). Applies to both kinds.

compute.description: Algorithm name, mapped to a gds client endpoint (e.g. pageRank -> gds.page_rank).

config.description: resultProperty names the produced node property; remaining keys are algorithm parameters in camelCase (e.g. maxIterations, dampingFactor, embeddingDimension), collapsed to snake_case before the client call.

resultProperty.description: Name of the node property this algorithm produces.

nodeProperty.description: A produced (compute resultProperty) to materialize into the in-session graph.
A produced (compute resultProperty) to persist to the database.

writeProperty.description: Optional DB property name (or output CSV column) to write to. Defaults to nodeProperty.

outputFile.description: Standalone sessions only: file (relative to the job config) this property is streamed to; format is .csv or .json by extension (.json mirrors the construct input file, with rows under a computedNodeProperties section), and properties sharing a file are written together. There is no database to write back to.
